scenes.headline: What is inside Taimi-14B-Med, and how it's deployed
scenes.sub: A medical model card, read top to bottom.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lark! Taimi-14B-Med is billed as a medical model for hospitals and service robots. Let's open the box and see what's actually in it.

scenes.label: What's in the box
scenes.text: At v0.1.0, Taimi-14B-Med is Qwen's 14B instruct model with a rebranded configuration. What ships new is how it is deployed.
scenes.say: At version zero point one, Taimi is Qwen's fourteen-billion-parameter instruct model with a rebranded configuration. The card says so, twice. What ships new is the deployment.

steps.say: At the bottom are Qwen's weights: forty-eight layers, forty query heads sharing eight key-value heads, quantized to four bits.
Version zero point one adds a rebranded configuration. Every architecture row on the card is the base model's.
vLLM serves it through an OpenAI-compatible API, for indicator questions, nursing guidance, alerts and nursing records.
The medical post-training, the whole premise, is planned for version zero point two or later.

scenes.title: Fitting 14B onto a 16 GB card
scenes.say: The part worth copying is the deployment: a fourteen-billion-parameter model on a sixteen-gigabyte consumer card.

items.say: The weights, in four-bit AWQ, take ten point three one gigabytes.
The key-value cache is kept in fp8.
And context is deliberately cut to four thousand and ninety-six tokens, not the thirty-two thousand the architecture allows.
The card measured the result on an RTX 5080, with headroom left for sixteen sequences at once.

scenes.title: CMExam accuracy
scenes.note: released in 2023; may overlap the base model's training data
scenes.say: On CMExam it scores seventy-seven point four, above the human baseline. But that measures the base model, and the exam may be in its training data.

scenes.text: The correction should live where the claim lives: base-model results should say so in the table's header.

recap: v0.1.0 is Qwen's base weights, renamed
AWQ, fp8 cache and short context fit 16 GB
Medical weights are planned for v0.2.0+
scenes.say: To recap: base weights under a new name, a smart sixteen-gigabyte deployment, and medical weights still to come.
